en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.15.
Sanidassanattika, Mahantaraduka
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-objective … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are thirty;
under the predominance condition there are thirty … pe … under the mutuality condition there are twenty-five … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-mental … (Abbreviated.)

With respect to root-cause: thirty; with respect to object: nine ... pe ... with respect to mutuality: twenty-five ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance: thirty. (The section on "not consciousness" is not obtained.
Dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, and non-reacting, and is not mental ... (Abbreviated. With respect to root-cause: thirty; with respect to object:
nine ... pe ... with respect to mutuality: twenty-five ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance: thirty.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not associated with consciousness … pe … dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not conjoined with consciousness … (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are thirty; under predominance condition there are thirty … pe … under mutuality condition there are twenty-five … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not originated by consciousness … pe … non-visible, non-reacting [state] … [and so forth].
Dependent on a state that is not co-nascent with consciousness … dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging,
and does not follow after consciousness … dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging,
and not conjoined with or produced by consciousness … dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and not conjoined with, produced by, or co-nascent with consciousness.
Dependent on ... [as before] ... dependent on a state that is non-corporeal, non-visual, with resistance, and not conjoined with, originated by, or following upon consciousness ...
(Abbreviated. Thirty in the case of root; nine in the case of object ... [as before] ... twenty-five in the case of mutuality ... thirty in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not internal … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are thirty; under object-condition, nine … pe … under mutuality-condition, twenty-five … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not external … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, nine.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not derived … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause condition (*hetu-paccaya*), there are twenty-five; in object condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), nine ... pe ... in non-disappearance condition (*avigata-paccaya*), twenty-five.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not-clung-to (*na-sanidassana-sappaṭigha-na-upādinnam dhammam paticca*) ... pe ... dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not-not-clung-to (*na-sanidassana-sappaṭigha-na-anupādinnam dhammam paticca*) ...

(Abbreviated. In the case of root-cause condition, there are thirty; in object condition, nine ... pe ... in mutuality condition (*aññamañña-paccaya*), twenty-five ... pe ... in non-disappearance condition, thirty.
